_note: Machine ladder for the storyboard deck (slide 08 and its appendix). Vendor and press figures, not Chagee data. Every figure comes from the source URL on its row; a gap is 'not_disclosed', never a guess. USD amounts convert at assumptions.json _meta.fx_sgd_per_usd. Prices are vendor list prices, not cost to implement (installation, training, maintenance, power, space and import are not included). Vendor speed or throughput claims are NOT model inputs: every rung uses the model's station speeds (assumptions.json stations). Station mapping ('replaces') is our assumption. model_rate_applies: the model's machine cost per station unit (assumptions.json costs.machine_cost_per_unit_per_month, a semi-automated station unit) is used as this rung's cost basis; robot rungs use only their own published price.
